query:
UPDATE channels
                 SET dedup_group = ?,
                     genre = COALESCE(genre, ?),
                     genre_source = CASE WHEN genre IS NULL AND ? IS NOT NULL
                                         THEN 'inferred' ELSE genre_source END,
                     category = COALESCE(genre, ?, collection, category),
                     enrich_status = 'done'
                 WHERE id = ?
